filter.description:
Optional filter string added to implicit query.

@see FetchFilterSpec#filter

doNotAppendHardwareFilter.description:
By default, hardware filter gets append to the {@link #filter}
false = 'instanceType.name == [machine name]'
true = '' no filter at all.
Use this flag to disable the hardware filter from being applied

doNotAppendBranchFilter.description:
By default, branch filter gets append to the {@link #filter}
true = 'gitBranch == [current branch]'
false = 'gitBranch == "v8only"' Only if the environment is JENKINS_AGENT_NAME is set, otherwise same as above
Use this flag to disable the branch filter from being applied

limit.description: Maximum number of records to fetch. Note that results are always the most recent ones.

outliersSpec.description: Options for outlier filtering. By default, a spec that filters by ±2σ is used.
